title: Eurorack "Vintage VCA" with the LM13700
summary: Step-by-step design of a Eurorack VCA around the LM13700: working out the OTA output level, converting its output current back to a voltage, and turning a 0–5 V CV into a safe Iabc control current.

sources.title: Design a Eurorack "Vintage VCA" with the LM13700
sources.author: Tom Wiltshire (Electric Druid)
